summary: 30-foot L-4 pole tower on Freezeout Ridge, built 1937 and destroyed about 1971; a 2025 visit reported cement footings on site.

facts.design: 30-foot pole L-4 tower, with an earlier log cabin and crow's nest (1912) and log cabin (1923)
facts.status_note: Tower destroyed about 1971; cement footings reported on site in a 2025 visit

staffing.status: Staff named through 1965 (Dan William Green); no later staffing source found

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1915 report names the Clearwater association and the two lookout sites name the Potlatch association. The associations ran separately until a 1966 merger, which accounts for the different names. The story reports both.
Idaho Fire Lookouts spells the 1919 staffer's surname Neisham, while the wedding notice spells the groom's name Niesham. Both spellings are reported as written.

notes_for_editor: Sources agree on the 1912, 1937 and 1971 dates. The record's two coordinate datasets disagree (46.99856, -116.02818 vs 47.01639, -116.02472); none of the pages read gives coordinates, so the record was not corrected. The sources give 11 miles east of Clarkia and township 42N, range 3E, section 12 (weebly page). The August 2025 visit report is the only current-condition source and is a visitor's account, not a survey. Staffing from 1915 onward comes from newspaper items quoted on two lookout sites.
